scripts.build: npm run build -w @of/shared && npm run build -w @of/orderflow && npm run build -w @of/exchange && npm run build -w @of/api && npm run build -w @of/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @of/shared && npm run build -w @of/orderflow && npm run build -w @of/exchange && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta --restart-tries 5 --restart-after 2000 "npm run dev -w @of/api" "npm run dev -w @of/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @of/orderflow && npm run test -w @of/api
